name: get_company_inventory
description: Read internal company inventory, sales averages, confirmed dated inbound shipments, supplier delays and purchasing rules. Fixed dummy snapshot; requested replenishment is not confirmed inbound.

name: get_replenishment_plan
description: Read a rule-based inventory replenishment optimization draft, ordered by stockout urgency and constrained by budget. Includes budget exclusions and a resource link to open the editor. This does not save a request.

name: get_replenishment_requests
description: Read the ten most recent registered request summaries. Supply an id or reference for five lines per page; use nextOffset for remaining lines. Reasons are truncated at 260 characters, with full text in the app. Requests are purchasing instructions, not confirmed shipments.
